fields.label: Beneficiary Category
fields.description: Who this specific line is funded by -- resolved from the matching Fee Structure Item's own override, or the Fee Structure's overall category otherwise. Lets one invoice mix e.g. BEAM-funded and parent-funded lines.

fields.label: Brought Forward
fields.description: Set only by Invoice._carry_forward_prior_balances() -- represents debt already recognized as income on an earlier invoice, not a new charge.

fields.label: Advance Applied
fields.description: Set only by Invoice._apply_available_advance() -- a negative line consuming a student's unapplied advance Receipt(s), not a real fee item.
